item.title: Devil's Representation
item.description: LDS President John Taylor taught God preserved the 'curse of Cain' through Noah's flood so 'the devil should have a representation upon the earth.'

item.title: We Cannot Tone It Down
item.description: John Taylor vowed they 'cannot tone down' polygamy and died in hiding. Six years later, the LDS Church abandoned the practice he swore to uphold.
